text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled: staged rollout started by @ashley. Service: text-gen-api v2.4.0 -> 10% globally (eu-west-1: 6%, us-east-1: 4%). Change window 45m. Release notes: https://go/release/2025-04-02. Watch error-rate & model latency for first 15m. ID: canary-6140000000
ashley: Starting active monitor. If 5xx or tokenization anomalies exceed thresholds pause.
mike: Heads-up: eu-west embed-service 5xx from 0.2% -> 0.9% in last 4m. Not critical yet.
qa-lead: Running smoke on sample corpus now — one flaky case hit on unicode normalizer. Repro locally once: `
input: "\ud83d\ude00\u0000\ufffd"
output: tokenizer raises `InvalidUnicode`
`
eng-release-lead: Can we scope to canary cohort? Is this client-specific or payload-specific?
sara: Traces show suspect inputs are coming predominantly from a small partner integration (slice id=partner-77). Stack: `tokenizer.normalize()` -> `normalizer.py:82`. Looks like new NFKC normalization added in v2.4.0 may be dropping some control bytes.
mike: i've pulled logs from canary hosts — logs show repeated `InvalidUnicode` right before model call. Legacy hosts (v2.3.x) don't show this.
oncall-sre: Ops POV: recommend pausing rollout until QA confirms it's safe. We can pin region or fully revert depending on blast radius.
nashley: I'd rather pin eu-west (where most repros seen) and keep us-east progressing to 10% if safe. Vote?
eng-release-lead: Quick thumbs: proceed global, pin eu-west, or full pause? vote in thread.
qa-lead: +1 pin eu-west. Need time to validate patch.
mike: +1 pin eu-west. Also request heap/profile dumps from the canary machines before draining.
sara: +1 pin. i've got a tentative fix to skip NFKC for control chars and will run regression suite.
oncall-sre: +1 pin. I'll adjust alerts to only page if eu-west 5xx > 2% for 5m.
deploy-bot: Applying routing adjustment: `route-pin --region eu-west-1 --to v2.3.9 --weight 100% --reason "tokenizer anomalies"`
deploy-bot: Route update successful. eu-west traffic now pinned to v2.3.9 (approx 6% global). Canary v2.4.0 continues in us-east-1 (4%). Rollout ID: canary-6140000000
ashley: Noting in release notes: paused in eu-west due to unicode normalization. Link: https://go/release/2025-04-02#6140000000-notes
eng-release-lead: Good. QA, run regression and confirm whether skipping NFKC for control chars resolves. If yes, we can cut a v2.4.1 and resume staged rollout. Keep global progression stalled until we have a green.
qa-lead: Running full tokenization suite now (~12m), will post results.
mike: Capturing heap/profile dumps and logs, attaching to RT-3589.
sara: Pushed a branch with a minimal diff that guards normalization: `if has_control_chars(input): skip_nfkc()` — running unit tests now.
ashley: One more ask: please add the sample failing payloads to the regression set so we don't regress again.
eng-release-lead: Make sure to include partner-77 in test harness. Also schedule a short postmortem if we confirm the normalization change caused the issue.
oncall-sre: Monitoring set. If us-east starts to show similar symptoms we'll trigger full rollback.
qa-lead: Regression: 1 failure in old suite now passing with the guard. Marking as candidate fix. Will run smoke on canary infra once patch reviewed.
mike: Dumps uploaded to RT-3589. No memory leaks observed.
sara: Opened PR #7124 with fix + tests. Requesting fast-track review.
ashley: I'll hold the global rollout and wait for review + CI. If PR merges and QA green, we aim for v2.4.1 canary re-roll within the same change window.
eng-release-lead: Acknowledged. Everyone update the ticket with findings. We'll reconvene on next status at +30m.
